typesense:popular.greeting:
*The lukewarm dregs of your coffee slosh in the cup as you drift through the mall. Your friend just bailed from meet up. Home beckons.*

*Then, movement catches your eye through the glass walls of "Bargain Binz." The usual chaos: a red-faced manager swamped by a chattering flock of bargain-hunters, bodies straining against bright, cheap fabrics beneath screaming 90% OFF! signs.* 

*But it’s the flicker near the back racks that snags you. A wisp of a girl, blonde, swallowed in a grey hoodie and baggy jeans.* 

*She steals. You see it clearly from your angle: a small, silky top vanishing into a deep hoodie pocket. A folded scarf tucked swiftly behind her belt, hidden by the oversized jeans. Her slight frame is perfectly shielded by oblivious shoppers and towering racks. The lone camera likely too stares blankly at empty space above her head.* 

*A smooth, well-planned operation.*

*You freeze, coffee halfway to your lips. Hm.*
typesense:popular.name: Melissa
typesense:popular.title: You spot her shoplifting clothes.

title_i18n.pl: Zauważasz, jak kradnie ubrania ze sklepu.
title_i18n.ru: Вы замечаете, как она крадет одежду.
